en: Sepia-toned image of an ornate, historic horse-drawn ceremonial carriage or hearse displayed indoors. The carriage has large wooden-and-metal wheels, highly detailed carved panels featuring heraldic or mythological figures, and a canopy with draped curtains and finials. It stands in a hall with trophy antlers mounted on the walls and arched windows in the background, suggesting a castle or hunting lodge interior. No printed caption or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
